preconditions.description: A and B must be integers

postconditions.description: The function must return either 'Mike', 'Joe', or 'Non-drinkers can't play'

postconditions.expression: A < 1 or B < 1 if return_value == 'Non-drinkers can't play' else True
postconditions.description: If the return value is 'Non-drinkers can't play', then either A or B must be less than 1

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Mike' if A >= sum(range(1, 2 * (A // 2 + 1), 2)) and B < sum(range(2, 2 * (B // 2 + 1), 2)) else True
postconditions.description: Mike wins if he can drink his required beers and Joe cannot drink his required beers

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Joe' if B >= sum(range(2, 2 * (B // 2 + 1), 2)) and A < sum(range(1, 2 * (A // 2 + 1), 2)) else True
postconditions.description: Joe wins if he can drink his required beers and Mike cannot drink his required beers
